unresolved: n_datasets not stated as a single number: each of the 5 applications uses its own original+external dataset pair drawn from multiple named sources (VGG-Face/LFW, speech corpus/Librispeech, Adience/LFW, movie review/question-classification, Udacity simulator, plus ILSVR2012 for a side experiment), so an exact distinct-dataset count could not be confidently derived.
n_seeds: paper never mentions repeated runs, trials, or random seeds for its reported accuracy/attack-success numbers; left null rather than assumed 1.

n_baselines: counted the internal neuron-selection algorithm (Table V), inner-vs-output-neuron design (Table VI), and the three failed alternative attack designs in Section V (incremental learning, model-parameter regression, arbitrary-trigger neuron finding) as comparison baselines; the paper does not label them uniformly as 'baselines' so this count is an interpretation.

n_eval_types: counted clean test accuracy, accuracy decrease/increase vs benign, attack success on original-domain stamped data, attack success on external stamped data, and attack-time/efficiency measurements as distinct evaluation types; case-specific metrics (one-off age accuracy, sum-of-squared-error for autonomous driving) were folded in rather than counted separately.
